notes.pipeline: Each attempt is research first, then planning, cheap implementation, deterministic/public/hidden checks, and a cheap ACCEPT/REJECT validator.
notes.models: Research and planning use the strongest configured model. Implementation and final mechanism/value validation use gpt-5.5 with low reasoning by default.
notes.campaign: Default campaign is five scientific iterations to reduce model spend. --max-cycles may override it up to seven. Infrastructure pauses do not consume a scientific iteration.
notes.benchmark: Public GOLD and hidden validation are regression guardrails, not the primary source of hypotheses. Safe flat benchmark results may reach the cheap validator; regressions are still rejected.
notes.real_tender: Research should primarily learn from the 130 review cases and 33 provisional-NOT_FOUND cases; the 90 first-pass labels are supporting evidence, not exhaustive final truth.
notes.review: The previous strong Reviewer/Fixer loop is simplified to one cheap gpt-5.5-low ACCEPT/REJECT validator after metric gates. No Fixer pass is budgeted.
notes.indexing: Agents may request a rebuild but must not run a full rebuild themselves. The supervisor owns the global budget of five rebuilds.
